assets.name: barge
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE large, high-resolution transparent game sprite, not a sprite sheet. Image 1 is the original painted circus steam barge to redesign. Preserve its polished hand-painted storybook game art, red wooden hull, brass rivets, purple pennants, striped canvas roofs and two bent smokestacks. Strict side view, bow LEFT, stern RIGHT, entire ship visible with transparent margins. Simplify the machinery into coherent mounted structures: at left the large circular drum has the cheerful clown face painted on its membrane; immediately ahead of it ONE large red/brass cannon, aimed horizontally LEFT, firmly seated on a thick pedestal attached to the bow deck. Its whole curved round bell muzzle is visible. Central teal boiler has a tall oval blue glass pressure tank framed in brass, extending down to deck height, a clearly visible vulnerable target. A broad curved copper pipe emerges from the lower left side of this tank and ends as a short flared nozzle pointing LEFT, clearly above the ship's rail, for shooting water. On the right rear deck a small striped-roof cabin with one visibly OPEN DARK EXIT doorway and a short sturdy diving ledge projecting beyond the right stern. The ledge has a rail behind it and an unobstructed right edge. The large right paddle wheel is intact and visible. No people, no clowns on board, no operators, no floating objects, no rear cannons, no tiny lower gun ports, no crane, no hammer or mallet, no cables, no strings. No water, no background, no smoke, no lettering. Crisp detailed large individual asset: spend resolution on the ship rather than repeated animation frames. Keep painted scale/shading of the reference.

assets.name: clown
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet, 4 equal cells in ONE horizontal row, each cell holds a whole flying circus clown at identical scale and center. Reference is the existing red clown, preserve EXACT recognizable face, round red nose, white face, curly red hair, red floppy cap with pale pink dots and gold bell, yellow frill collar, red suit with pale pink polka dots, white gloves and oversized curled red shoes. Side view, flying toward LEFT, arms reaching forward. Anatomically clear two separate legs, two distinct shoes with empty transparent gap between legs. Absolutely no striped tube, no swaddling, no bound legs, no worm tail, no speed-line smear. Four consecutive flying poses: 1 launch stretched with one knee bent upward and other leg trailing; 2 hands forward legs slightly apart; 3 airborne knees bent as preparing to tumble; 4 arms forward one foot lifted and one leg extended. Head roughly at x35% of each cell, center y45%, feet at right. Clean golden shaded painted storybook sprite matching reference, expressive mischievous smile. Keep same face identity across all cells. No cannon, no background, no effects, no labels; true alpha.
